identity.description: A small accounting office that does your taxes, keeps your books and answers the phone. Flat prices quoted before we start, and meetings in person or by video.
identity.story:
Dana Whitfield opened the office in 2011 after twelve years at a downtown firm, with one desk and a promise to return every call the same day.

Today a team of five looks after about 400 households and 120 small businesses, from food trucks to dental offices, and we still answer our own phone.

faqs.question: What should I bring to the first meeting?
faqs.answer: Last year's return, this year's W-2s and 1099s, and any letters from the IRS or the state. We send a checklist when you book.

faqs.question: Can we meet by video?
faqs.answer: Yes. About half our clients never visit the office, and you can send documents through a secure link.

faqs.question: Do you work with people outside Burbank?
faqs.answer: Yes, anywhere in California, and we file in most other states for clients who moved.

posts.title: Five things to do before tax season
posts.excerpt: A short checklist that saves you time and money in April.
posts.body_md:
**Tax season** opens in late January, and a little work now makes it painless.

## Before you book

- Keep each *1099* as it arrives
- Write down big changes: a move, a new baby, a new business
- Check your estimated payments

Spots fill up in March, so [book yours early](https://book.example/larkspur-tax).
